newsitem.title: UK: ECGD backs loan to modernise Russian sugar factory.
newsitem.headline: ECGD backs loan to modernise Russian sugar factory.

text.p: Britain's Export Credits Guarantee Department (ECGD) said on Thursday it was backing a 22 million stg loan to help a British company raise the output capacity of a sugar factory in Russia.

The ECGD said Fletcher Smith Ltd won a contract to design, supply and supervise the building and commissioning of machinery to modernise a beet factory at Erken Shakharsky in the Karachaevo-Cherkessk Republic.
Fletcher Smith, based in Derby, won the contract in association with the London-based Dashwood Group of London, the ECGD said in a statement.

"ECGD is guaranteeing the repayment of a 22 million stg loan arranged by HSBC Investment Bank plc, and provided by Midland Bank, to Moscow's Vnesheconombank to finance the contract," the statement said.
"After completion of the modernisation work, the factory should be able to process up to 7,500 tonnes of beet per day," it said.
The contract was awarded by V/O Technopromimport as part of the Russian Federation's programme to increase food production within the country.
